senses.gloss:
f. (-वा)
1 The neck.
2 The back part of the neck, the nape, the tendon of the Trapezium muscle.
E.
गॄ to swallow, वन् Uṇādi affix, ईट् inserted.

mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि)
Long-necked, handsome-necked.
m. (-वी)
A camel.
E.
ग्रीवा a neck, and इनि poss. aff.

mfn. (-ष्मः-ष्मा-ष्मं)
Hot, warm.
m. (-ष्मः)
1 The hot season, comprehending two months, about June-July.
2 Heat, warmth.
f. (-ष्मी)
Jasmin.
E.
ग्रस to take, &c. मक् Uṇādi affix, and the deriv. irr.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Produced by heat.
2 Produced in the hot season.
f. (-जा)
A kind of fruit, (Annona reticulata.)
E.
ग्रीष्म the hot season, and ज produced.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced by heat or in the hot season.
f. (-वा)
Double jasmin: see नवमल्ली.
E.
ग्रीष्म the hot season, and भव being, flourishing.

m. (-कः)
A kind of potherb, (Chironia centauroides; it is also applied to Pharnaceum mollugo.)
E.
ग्रीष्म the hot season, and सुन्दर handsome, affix कन्.

n. (-सं)
The flocculent seeds, down, &c. blown about in the air.
E.
ग्रीष्म the hot season, and हास a smile, considered, from their white colour, as the smiles of the season.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Produced by heat or in the hot season.
f. (-वा)
Double jasmin.
E.
ग्रीष्म, and उद्भब produced.
